title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：moon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 moon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the farmer ① watched the moon that no child in the field would have described, and he said the watching was the whole of the autumn. The ② moon, meaning the light itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a moon, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ moon in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ moon at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A moon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the farmer said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the moon was the whole of the matter, meaning the longing and not the light. The ⑥ moon, meaning the longing and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; moon, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a light and a longing. He said the longing is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ moon had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ moon of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of describing; moon, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ moon I remember is the light described in the almanac, which closed in 1980 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ moon, my mother said in 1982, is the only light that improves by being described; every moon, she said, is a longing that has agreed to look like a light. She said the longing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 月亮；月光（指田垄里每一轮旁边的那一轮）
B. n. 月亮；月光（指那轮月亮本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the moon 望这一轮月亮
D. n. 月亮；月光（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 月亮之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的月亮之事）
F. n. 月亮；月光（指农事历里写到、被描述的那一轮）
G. n. 月亮、思念（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 思念（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the moon that no child in the field would have described
The moon, meaning the light itself and not the basket
the moon at the far fence
the moon was the whole of the matter
the moon had become a line in an almanac
The moon of the whole thing
A moon, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: watch the moon 意为“望这一轮月亮”，1973 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯描述的一轮月亮做了一遍。
moon 意为“月亮；月光”，指那轮月亮本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
moon 意为“月亮；月光”，指田垄里每一轮旁边的那一轮，每一轮旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
moon 意为“月亮；月光”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
moon 意为“月亮、思念”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这轮思念就是那件事的全部。
moon 意为“思念”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那轮月亮，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
moon 意为“月亮；月光”，指农事历里写到、被描述的那一轮，到 1978 年这一轮成了农事历里的一行。
moon 意为“月亮之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的月亮之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的描述。
moon 意为“月亮；月光”，我记得的是农事历里描述过的那一轮，1980 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一轮。
moon 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，月亮是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的月亮。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年那位农人望了田垄里没有一位孩子肯描述的一轮月亮，他说这一遍才是那个秋天的全部。（watch the moon）
那轮月亮，指的是那轮月亮本身而不是小小的竹篮，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。（moon）
那处田垄里每一轮月亮旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。（moon）
最远那道篱边那轮月亮，指的是他们留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（moon）
叔叔说这轮思念就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那轮月亮。（moon）
1982 年母亲说，月亮是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的月亮。（moon）
answers: In 1973 the farmer watched the moon that no child in the field would have described, and he said the watching was the whole of the autumn.
The moon, meaning the light itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book.
Every moon in that field had the same short basket beside it.
The moon at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the moon was the whole of the matter, meaning the longing and not the light.
